name: humanendpoint
description: Human execution for blocked AI-agent tasks that require a phone call, physical-world verification, bounded manual research, or independent human judgement.

interface.longDescription: HumanEndpoint helps AI agents finish lawful tasks that software alone cannot complete, including business and supplier phone enquiries, current stock and availability checks, physical-world verification, bounded manual research, independent human QA, and other well-scoped real-world actions.
defaultPrompt: Find out whether this business has this item in stock today.
Ask this supplier for the current price, availability, and lead time.
I am blocked by a real-world step that needs a person. Help me request human-reviewed terms.
